label: representative nested price with original PriceType XML block
schema:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:t="urn:bosak:nested-plan"
 targetNamespace="urn:bosak:nested-plan" elementFormDefault="qualified">
  <xs:complexType name="OrderType">
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="line" type="t:LineType" minOccurs="1" maxOccurs="2"/>
      <xs:element name="approved" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:sequence>
    <xs:attribute name="id" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
  </xs:complexType>
  <xs:complexType name="LineType">
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="sku" type="xs:string"/>
      <xs:element name="quantity" type="xs:integer"/>
      <xs:element name="price" type="t:PriceType"/>
    </xs:sequence>
  </xs:complexType>
<xs:complexType name="PriceType">
    <xs:simpleContent>
      <xs:extension base="xs:decimal">
        <xs:attribute name="currency" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
      </xs:extension>
    </xs:simpleContent>
  </xs:complexType>
<xs:element name="price" type="t:PriceType"/>
  <xs:element name="order" type="t:OrderType"/>
</xs:schema>
